Class CharacterChooseController

java.lang.Object
app.controller.multi.CharacterChooseController
public class CharacterChooseController extends Object
This class manages the functionality of the character selection screen in a multiplayer game. It handles player interactions, message communication with the server, and manages the state of character selections and ready status of players.

  • Method Details

    • drawPane

      public void drawPane()
      Initializes and renders the character selection pane by setting up the main interface elements, event handlers, and establishing a communication mechanism with the server.

      This method performs the following steps: - Calls initPage() to set the scene's root to the main pane and configures default styles. - Triggers the generation of the main character selection interface via mainView.generate(). - Establishes the server communication handler by assigning this::handleServerMessage to handle incoming server messages and starts listening for server communications using Client.listen(). - Catches and logs IOException that may occur during the server communication setup. - Configures user interaction by setting up character-related event listeners using setupCharacterEvents(). - Configures ready-state event listeners using setupReadyEvents().

      This method must be called to properly initialize and display the character selection interface and ensure server interactions are handled. Any failure during server communication does not interrupt the setup of the UI components.
